public_semantics.source_family: Apache Kafka transactional producer epoch fencing
public_semantics.binding: Kafka checks producer_epoch against the broker current epoch and errors on mismatch; current Kafka transactional protocol bumps producer epoch per transaction. This is used only as public precedent for generation fencing. The role-local controller itself supplies the durable abort tombstone, exactly-once reservation release, width accounting, and frozen queue order.
public_semantics.scope_limit: Constructed role-local controller trace only; no claim of Kafka equivalence, production safety, MCTS performance, or richer-mode parity beyond this tested race mechanism.
